title: What happened
paragraphs: On Monday, 7 September, at 4.30 in the morning, a fire destroyed the family house in Riacho He Hé, Formosa. The flames took most of the home and everything inside it.
Norma died in that fire. Her husband got out, but he inhaled a great deal of smoke and today his lung capacity is at 50%. He is in treatment and needs time and care to recover.

These are the photographs of that night and of what was left. They appear here once, because anyone who is going to help needs to know what happened, and they do not appear again on the rest of the site.

hero.alt: A firefighter in a helmet and breathing apparatus steps through the doorway of the house at night. The wall is aqua green and through the barred window the orange glow of the fire inside is visible.

testimony.quote: My focus now is rebuilding my father's house and walking with him through his recovery.
testimony.author: Justo Miguel Vargas

photoEssay.heading: What was left
photoEssay.note: The photographs the family took when they went in, before anything was removed.

photos.alt: The front of the house in daylight. The sea-green wall is stained black above the window and the paint has lifted from the heat. The sheet metal of the eaves is twisted.
photos.caption: The front, from the street.

photos.alt: A room with no roof. The walls are bare brick, black in one corner; a burned timber beam hangs in the empty space and the floor is covered in rubble.
photos.caption: Inside, there was no roof left.

photos.alt: The garage with a burned-out car in the centre. The walls and the sheet-metal roof are black and the floor is covered in burned remains.
photos.caption: The car, in the garage.

needNow.title: What is needed now
paragraphs: The house has to be rebuilt. It is a job the family cannot take on alone.
That is what this campaign is for: to raise what is needed and to rebuild the house.
Thank you to everyone who came close, wrote and is standing with us at this time.
